definitions.gloss: large sum of money, large amount of money
definitions.explanation: A large amount specifically referring to money or financial value.

examples.japanese: {多額|たがく}の{借金|しゃっきん}がある。
{研究|けんきゅう}に{多額|たがく}の{費用|ひよう}が{投|とう}じられた。
examples.english: A large sum was invested in the research.

examples.japanese: {詐欺|さぎ}グループに{多額|たがく}の{現金|げんきん}をだまし{取|と}られる{被害|ひがい}が{相次|あいつ}いでいる。
examples.english: Cases of large sums of cash being swindled by fraud groups are occurring one after another.

notes:
{多額|たがく} combines {多|た} (many, much) and {額|がく} (amount, sum). It is used exclusively for monetary amounts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多額|たがく}の{借金|しゃっきん} (large debt)
- {多額|たがく}の{費用|ひよう} (large cost)
- {多額|たがく}の{寄付|きふ} (large donation)
- {多額|たがく}の{投資|とうし} (large investment)
- {多額|たがく}の{損害|そんがい} (large financial damages)

USAGE:
Always used with the particle の before the noun it modifies: {多額|たがく}の + money-related noun. Unlike {大金|たいきん} (large sum), {多額|たがく} is more formal and commonly seen in news and official writing.
